title: netstats v1

data.$comment: Q4a answered 18 Aug 2026: eth0 and wwan are MANDATORY. Additional interfaces are allowed and are validated against the same interface shape via patternProperties, so a new interface name never requires a schema change (STA-14A).

interface.$comment: apipa is OPTIONAL and deliberately so: in the only sample ZC supplied, eth0 carries apipa and wwan does not. Requiring it would reject ZC's own record. additionalProperties stays true per D14 - unknown data fields are accepted and preserved.

ipv4.$comment: IPv4 only in v1. IPv6 is not in the sample and is not accepted; see the open item in docs/decisions/2B-ANSWERS-18AUG2026.md.

counter.$comment: Counters stay STRINGS on the wire because that is what Heimdal sends, but they are constrained to digits only so a non-numeric value fails at ingest with a 400 rather than failing a cast at query time. Capped at 19 digits, which rejects anything above 9999999999999999999. The remaining gap between the signed BIGINT maximum 9223372036854775807 and that ceiling cannot be expressed as a regex, so the Writer MUST range-check before conversion - an unchecked overflow corrupts the value with no error.

$comment: Q4a answered 18 August 2026. Strict validation: eth0/wwan mandatory, other interfaces allowed, apipa optional, counters remain strings on the wire and are stored as BIGINT.
